messages:
riley: FYI the Docusaurus build on the mdx branch started failing linkcheck for a handful of anchors that include emojis and inline flags (eg. `🚀 Quickstart`).

ci-bot: build: docs/docusaurus: linkcheck failed (exit 2). 7 broken fragment links. see https://ci.redwood/example/7012 for details :warning:

zoe: sample errors from the log:
```
WARNING: broken link: ../getting-started#quickstart -> 404
WARNING: broken link: ../guides/upgrade#v1-to-v2 -> 404
```
Both those pages still exist but the slug generator for mdx removed emoji and collapsed punctuation so the fragments changed.

arun: this is the mdx slugifier behaviour. emoji stripped, accents normalized, inline code turned into raw text then slugified. older links were written manually expecting a different slug.

riley: options: 1) add explicit ids to the headings (e.g. `## 🚀 Quickstart {#quickstart}`), 2) add redirect entries in the docusaurus plugin (longer term), 3) update internal references to use new slugs (risky, big ripples). I prefer 1 + a redirects file for the handful of legacy anchors that external docs link to.

zoe: doing explicit ids for the flagged headings seems safest and reviewable. i'll open a small PR that touches only the 6 files in the CI log. will use ascii kebab-case ids. also add a short note in CONTRIBUTING about explicit ids for headings with emoji/code.

arun: add a short integration test too: a tiny ci job that parses docusaurus linkcheck output and fails PRs with broken fragments and attaches a list of suggested ids. i've prototyped a script that maps linkcheck failures to candidate headings.

docs-scan-bot: suggestion: consider adding a `legacy-anchors.json` redirect map in the site config to handle external links (search engines, partners). filed https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/issues/223 for tracking.

zoe: PR draft: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/4499 — adds explicit ids for 6 headings and CONTRIBUTING blurb, plus `scripts/suggest_anchor_ids.py` to help reviewers.

ci-bot: note: linkcheck will re-run after PR updates. :info:

arun: small nit: prefer ids like `quickstart` rather than `rocket-quickstart`. keep them short and consistent.

riley: +1. keep ids predictable. once this merges we'll run a full site deploy and monitor canonical URLs / search indexing.

zoe: pushed the fix and ran mkdocs/docusaurus locally; fragments jump correctly on staging. looking for a quick review.

riley: reviewing now. if green i'll merge and file a follow-up for the redirects map and CI annotation bot.

(last) arun: thanks team  hard to catch emoji slug quirks without linkcheck. merging once CI is green. :thumbsup:
